policy: Direct peer-reviewed orthology can be used as a strict species-level anchor only when the exact source species and gene are explicitly identified as orthologous in a peer-reviewed study, the study reports phylogenetic support that includes Homo sapiens in the same gene-family analysis, and the nominated human Ensembl target is independently validated. This does not imply that the ortholog is the causal mechanism of the claim.

Paracentrotus lividus.paralog_discrimination: Bilaterian WNT subfamilies were resolved; P. lividus WNT2 was highlighted inside the WNT2 subfamily while Homo sapiens WNT sequences were included in the same analyses.
Paracentrotus lividus.bridge_scope: species-level strict orthology anchor only; the preservation/cryopreservation translation path remains the separate DMSO/trehalose functional bridge
Paracentrotus lividus.rationale: Robert et al. 2019 explicitly identify a WNT2 ortholog in Paracentrotus lividus and report both Maximum Likelihood and Bayesian phylogenetic analyses with Homo sapiens WNT sequences included.
